summary: TG Therapeutics filed an 8-K announcing positive topline results from the Phase 3 ENHANCE trial for BRIUMVI, evaluating a consolidated single-infusion initiation regimen for relapsing multiple sclerosis. The trial met its primary endpoint of bioequivalence between the current two-infusion schedule and a single 600 mg dose on Day 1. No financial terms, premium, or deal mechanics are involved. The registrant is the issuer reporting clinical milestone. This is an operational update, not a special-situation transaction. Watch for supplemental BLA filing in 2H 2026.
